Title: Yet More Slake the Thirst Questions

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Ok, two questions about Slake the Thirst. Assume there are 4 untapped,
4 capacity Blood Brothers of the same circle. Blood Brother A has 3 of
4 blood and SAN taps to take an inferior Unwholesome Bond action,
which would gain him 4 blood (3 untapped BBs +1). He then plays
superior Slake the Thirst to give blood to Blood Brother B.

A) Does Blood Brother B gain 4 blood (the amount that BB A would get
from the successful action) or 1 blood (the amount of blood BB A
actually ends up with after the extra blood drains off, as BB A
started at 3 of 4 blood)?

B) Can Blood Brother B then also play a Slake the Thirst to give Blood
Brother C the amount of blood he gained?

Thanks,
-Peter

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Apr 1, 10:52 am, Peter D Bakija <p...@lightlink.com> wrote:
> Ok, two questions about Slake the Thirst. Assume there are 4 untapped,
> 4 capacity Blood Brothers of the same circle. Blood Brother A has 3 of
> 4 blood and SAN taps to take an inferior Unwholesome Bond action,
> which would gain him 4 blood (3 untapped BBs +1). He then plays
> superior Slake the Thirst to give blood to Blood Brother B.

So BB-A gains 4 blood and plays Slake the Thirst.

> A) Does Blood Brother B gain 4 blood (the amount that BB A would get
> from the successful action) or 1 blood (the amount of blood BB A
> actually ends up with after the extra blood drains off, as BB A
> started at 3 of 4 blood)?

BB-A gains 4, so BB-B gains 4.

> B) Can Blood Brother B then also play a Slake the Thirst to give Blood
> Brother C the amount of blood he gained?

No. He is not acting, so cannot play it as an action modifier, and he
is not in combat, so cannot play it as a combat card.
